pkgmetadata.longdescription: A GTK4/libadwaita application store for Gentoo's Portage: search, install and manage packages with a live job queue, USE-flag, keyword and license conflict resolution, and checks for security advisories, unread news, pending config updates, a stale tree and orphaned packages. Ships a CLI companion (portage-store-cli). Privileged operations go through a single root-owned helper behind one doas rule.

use.flag: Enable the in-app "Learn More" web view via net-libs/webkit-gtk (large dependency; links open in the system browser when off)
